Context: 8. Maternity Leave

3. Admissible only to Rule 43 (1).
4. (b) Miscarriage/Abortion (induced or otherwise): Total of 45 days in the entire service excluding any such leave taken prior to 16-6-1994. Admissible irrespective of number of surviving children. Application should be supported by a certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner for NGOs and from AMA for GOs. - Rule 43 (3).
2. The leave is not debited to the leave account.
3. It is granted on full pay.
4. It may be combined with leave of any other kind.
